query: Which operational accessibility metrics and thresholds will we predefine (e.g., population-weighted travel time, % vulnerable within 10/15 min, travel-time distributions) and how will we report them?

response.query: Which operational accessibility metrics and thresholds will we predefine (e.g., population-weighted travel time, % vulnerable within 10/15 min, travel-time distributions) and how will we report them?
response.answer: Predefined operational accessibility metrics include population-weighted travel time and percentage of vulnerable populations within 10/15 minutes. Reporting will use travel-time distributions. Thresholds will be set based on these metrics.
